items.title: Penguin 3
items.text:
Welcome to Penguin 3!

The game where penguins go collect garbage.

Check out the sidebar for more info!

items.title: Closing Penguin 3
items.text: To close Penguin 3, click or enter any of these.

items.title: Install Penguin 3
items.text:
To install Penguin 3, you can double-click penguin_3_whole_install.bat (or penguin_3_whole_install if extensions are hidden).

Info

To only install required dependencies, click install.bat.

items.title: Open Penguin 3
items.text:
To open Penguin 3, you may double-click play.bat (or play if extensions are hidden) in the penguin-3-main folder.

Do not double-click main.py.

With Python working directories they hate you.

items.title: Penguin
items.text:
Your penguin collects garbage because they want to.

Want to what?

They want to collect garbage to earn money.

items.title: Sub-keywords
items.text:
You can use sub-keywords for keywords that need it, like help and penguin. First, check what they are about. It says to put a number after penguin. We should try that out.

Cool!

And that's how you use sub-keywords.

items.title: Typing in Penguin 3
items.text: You can type keywords in the grey entry box. Press Enter for it to receive. You can see help by typing "help" in it.

items.title: Using help
items.text: Penguins sometimes need help. They can do it by typing "help" and pressing enter.

items.title: Navigating help
items.text:
By default, help shows everything.

Keywords are what you type into the box. The meanings are provided by the game. Sub-keywords are what you put after the keyword. There are other knowledge to know about. You can also read on how to use sub-keywords.

items.title: Long and short
items.text: You can see the short help like this: help short. It is like this by default. You can also see the long version: help long. This shows more information.

items.title: Specific sections
items.text: You can see help for specific sections. For example, typing help short penguin. This gives short help on the command penguin. Or, you can do help short other. This shows help for the section Other.
